# Chow groups of projective space are generated by linear subspaces

## Status

New article from the projective-cycle-rational-equivalent-linear-space split (roadmap
proposal). Lean for the linear subspaces and two special cases exists (below), but nothing is
recorded in the frontmatter: Formalize should record declarations only after independent
review.

Source: Fulton, *Intersection Theory*, §1.9 (the Chow groups of affine and projective space via
the exact sequence of Prop. 1.8). The exact example number in Fulton was not confirmed offline;
check it before recording. This is the normalization-defined analogue of
projective-space-chow-ring (Hartshorne Example A.2.0.1), which is stated for the axiomatic
theory and uses homotopy invariance; the proof here avoids homotopy invariance by proving
`A^{n-m}(𝔸ⁿ) = 0` (`m < n`) directly, so it does not depend on chow-affine-homotopy-invariance
or chow-localization-exact-sequence (both not ready). No edge was added to
projective-space-chow-ring; a later pass may cross-link the two.

## Existing Lean (module `Hartshorne.Intersection.ProjectiveLinearSubspaceCycle`)

Candidates to record here once reviewed (all sorry-free, standard axioms):

- `Hartshorne.projectiveSpaceStructureMorphism`, `Hartshorne.finiteType_projectiveSpaceStructureMorphism`,
  the `IsSeparated` instance, `Hartshorne.bijective_algebraMap_homogeneousSubmodule_zero`.
- `Hartshorne.topologicalKrullDim_projectiveSpace`, `Hartshorne.projectiveSpaceOrderIso`,
  `Hartshorne.krullDim_projectiveSpectrum`.
- `Hartshorne.ker_aeval_ite_eq_span_X_image`, `Hartshorne.isPrime_span_X_image`,
  `Hartshorne.X_mem_span_X_image_iff`.
- `Hartshorne.linearSubspaceIdeal`, `Hartshorne.linearSubspaceSpectrumPoint`,
  `Hartshorne.linearSubspacePoint` (the article's `L_m`), `Hartshorne.linearSubspaceIdeal_succ_lt`,
  `Hartshorne.linearSubspaceSpectrumPoint_succ_lt` (`L_m ⊂ L_{m+1}`, used for `L_m ⊆ V(xₙ)`),
  `Hartshorne.height_linearSubspaceSpectrumPoint`, `Hartshorne.codim_closure_linearSubspacePoint`,
  `Hartshorne.codim_closure_projectiveSpace_point`.
- `Hartshorne.pointCodimensionCycle`, `Hartshorne.pointCodimensionCycle_apply`.
- Special cases: `Hartshorne.eq_linearSubspacePoint_of_codim_eq_zero` (the base case `m = n`),
  and `Hartshorne.rationallyEquivalent_degree_smul_linearSubspace_of_codim_eq_one` with
  `Hartshorne.projectiveHyperplanePrimeDivisor_X_last` (the case `m = n - 1`, which already gives
  the multiple explicitly).

## Candidate statement

For `y : Proj 𝒜` with `hy : codim (closure {y}) = n - m`, `m ≤ n`:
`∃ a : ℤ, RationallyEquivalent projectiveSpaceStructureMorphism
finiteType_projectiveSpaceStructureMorphism topologicalKrullDim_projectiveSpace
(pointCodimensionCycle y hy) (a • pointCodimensionCycle (linearSubspacePoint m) _)`.
Name suggestion: `Hartshorne.exists_rationallyEquivalent_zsmul_linearSubspace`. This is exactly
the second hypothesis of `Hartshorne.rationallyEquivalent_degree_smul_linearSubspace_of_exists`.

## Lean gaps

- The localization article (new, no Lean).
- `A^r(𝔸ⁿ) = 0` for `r > 0`: needs a linear change of coordinates making a projection finite on
  `Y` (the linear form of Noether normalization over an infinite field). Mathlib's
  `exists_finite_inj_algHom_of_fg` (`Mathlib/RingTheory/NoetherNormalization.lean`) is
  not linear and does not give a projection `𝔸ⁿ → 𝔸ⁿ⁻¹`. Also needed: normality of `B[t]` for
  normal `B`, and primality of a monic irreducible `g` in `B[t]` for integrally closed `B`.
- Identifying `ℙⁿ - V(xₙ)` with `𝔸ⁿ` and `V(xₙ)` with `ℙⁿ⁻¹` compatibly with `L_m`.
